name: Render resolution 1920x1080, output 1920x1080
description: Output and render resolution 1920x1080. Choose Performance in the game's graphics settings first. The first two writes are the display mode (the game's default output is 3840x2160); they are held: the game writes them again later and the patch follows. The game computes the render size from the display size and a table of scales of its upscaler quality modes (0.769, 0.667, 0.588, 0.5; Performance uses 0.667, so 1280x720 at a 1080p output). The last write sets that table to 1.0, so the game itself computes a 1920x1080 render size (holding the render size instead is a race: other game threads read it while it changes, and the picture comes out cropped or doubled). The third and fourth writes hold the render size where the game computes 854x480 first (seen in KytyPS5). Use only one variant.
author: batatinhafcbatatinha-pixel
tested: AnyPS5 (2026-11-17, new GPU engine, `tools/ps5port` with the file in the port's patches folder), RTX 3050 laptop GPU (8 GB), Ryzen 5 3600: display and render size 1920x1080 (read in game memory, 1920x1080 color targets), right picture in the menus and in gameplay, about 47 fps in the bank scene of the prologue, 300 s runs without a crash. KytyPS5 fork (2026-11-17, before the scale-table write): display mode and render size 1920x1080 confirmed in the log; not yet run with the scale-table write.
